scientific_integrity: Infinite results proved by explicit Poisson variance and Hilbert matrix estimates; standalone finite checker is corroborative; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact norms and ratio concern the specific logarithmic symbol; do not establish a universal gap or resolve the existence of unbounded SRKT symbols. Unindexed equivalent calculations remain a risk.
title: An exact square-root-two SRKT gap for the logarithmic Hilbert Hankel symbol
